challenges.title: Three-Way Sign Test
challenges.description:
Given a `t40` value `x`, return its ternary sign — `-1` if negative, `0` if zero, `+1` if positive.

### Constraints
- Do not use `if` statements. The three-arm `match` construct is the intended solution mechanism. All three arms must be present.

### Examples
- `sign_test(-42)` → `-1`
- `sign_test(0)` → `0`
- `sign_test(99)` → `+1`

challenges.title: Ternary FizzBuzz
challenges.description:
Given an integer `N`, print numbers from `1` to `N` (inclusive).
    
For each number `i`:
- If `i` is a multiple of 3, print `"Trit"` followed by a newline.
- Otherwise, print `i` followed by a newline (using `sys_write_int` and `sys_newline`).

### Constraints
- `1 <= N <= 50`

### Example Output for N = 5
```text
1
2
Trit
4
5
```

challenges.title: Three-State Machine
challenges.description: Design a simple finite state machine using three-valued logic state values. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Null Pointer Safety Chain
challenges.description: Safely traverse a chain of pointers, handling any null pointer states securely. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Validated Buffer Walk
challenges.description:
Given a pointer to a null-terminated ASCII string, invert the characters of the string **in-place**.
    
You must reverse the string in the allocated buffer without using extra string memory allocations.

### Constraints
- String length up to 50 characters.
- Memory pointer is guaranteed to be `valid` and accessible.

### Example
- Input: `"hello"`
- Output: `"olleh"`
challenges.signature: fn invert_string(str: borrow<ptr<t40, user, valid>>) -> t40

challenges.title: Ownership Transfer Chain
challenges.description: Implement ownership transfer mechanics across multiple worker context queues. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Balanced Ternary Addition
challenges.description: Implement carry-save balanced ternary addition. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Sign-Free Absolute Value
challenges.description: Compute the absolute value of a balanced ternary number without explicit branch testing. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Ternary Integer Square Root
challenges.description: Compute the integer square root using base-3 binary-search variants. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Big Integer Limb Multiply
challenges.description: Implement large limb multiplication matching Montgomery reduction layouts. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: TLDR/TSTR Atomic Counter
challenges.description: Implement a thread-safe atomic counter using Triton-27 TLDR and TSTR assembly primitives. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Lock-Free Stack
challenges.description: Build a lock-free stack using hardware-native CAS-like instructions. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Split Buffer Claim Race
challenges.description: Coordinate buffer claims across parallel Triton threads under high contention. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Ternary Search on Sorted Array
challenges.description: Implement logarithmic search partitioning the search space into three equal parts. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Three-Way Partition Quicksort
challenges.description: Implement Dutch National Flag partition logic for array sorting. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: TST String Interning
challenges.description: Implement a Ternary Search Tree for space-efficient string interning lookup. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Ternary Heap Priority Queue
challenges.description: Implement a 3-ary heap priority queue with log3-bound insertion complexity. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Montgomery Ladder Step
challenges.description: Coordinate constant-time ladder steps to protect against timing attacks. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Constant-Time Comparison
challenges.description: Evaluate memory block equality with uniform instructions to prevent side-channel leaks. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Execute-Only Page Guard
challenges.description: Enforce execute-only page table permissions in Virtual Memory structures. (Compile Check Only Mode)

challenges.title: Three-State Conway's Game
challenges.description: Implement a Conway's Game of Life variant on a grid using three states: dead (-1), dormant (0), and alive (+1). Birth and survival rules use T1 comparisons on neighbor counts.
challenges.signature: fn conway_step(grid: borrow<[t1]>, width: t40, height: t40, next_grid: borrow_mut<[t1]>) -> t40

challenges.title: Ternary Run-Length Encoding
challenges.description: Given a t40 array, encode it as a sequence of (value, count) pairs. Use a three-arm match on value equality to drive the state machine cleanly.
challenges.signature: fn encode_rle(in_arr: borrow<[t40]>, out_val: borrow_mut<[t40]>, out_count: borrow_mut<[t40]>) -> t40

challenges.title: Balanced Logic Evaluator
challenges.description: Evaluate an expression tree where AND/OR/NOT operations act on T1 values. Note that T1 is not a standard bool: -1 is False, 0 is Unknown, +1 is True. E.g., (-1) AND (+1) is False, but (0) OR (+1) is True.
challenges.signature: fn evaluate_expr(nodes: borrow<[t40]>, left: borrow<[t40]>, right: borrow<[t40]>, root: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Three-Way String Classifier
challenges.description: Given a character code (t40), return: neg (-1) if it's a control character, zero (0) if it's whitespace, or pos (+1) if it's a printable character. Use range comparisons returning T1 with one match block and no lookup tables.

challenges.title: Ternary Carry Propagation
challenges.description: Given a t40 array of trit digits in {-1, 0, +1}, normalize them into a balanced ternary format with no outstanding carries. Perform carry-chain handling iteratively using TCMP.

challenges.title: Nullable Field Chain
challenges.description: Safely traverse a nested field chain a.b.c where each field pointer is of type ptr<t40, user, unknown>. Ensure every pointer state is checked before dereferencing to prevent compilation failures.
challenges.signature: fn access_chain(a: ptr<ptr<t40, user, unknown>, user, unknown>) -> t40

challenges.title: Pointer Chain Reversal
challenges.description: Reverse a singly linked list in-place where next links are ptr<Node, user, unknown>. Ensure pointer states are validated and tracked correctly after updating each link.
challenges.signature: fn reverse_list(head: ptr<t40, user, unknown>) -> ptr<t40, user, unknown>

challenges.title: Move Without Copy
challenges.description: Transfer ownership of a heap-allocated buffer through three successive function calls without cloning or copying. The compiler will check that the source binding is invalidated immediately after each transfer.
challenges.signature: fn process_buffer(buf: own<ptr<t40, user, valid>>) -> own<ptr<t40, user, valid>>

challenges.title: Safe Arena Allocator
challenges.description: Implement a basic bump allocator over a fixed memory arena. Return ptr<t40, user, valid> on successful allocation, and ptr<t40, user, null> on exhaustion. Callers must validate pointer status before using the memory.
challenges.signature: fn arena_alloc(arena: borrow_mut<ptr<t40, user, valid>>, size: t40, end: ptr<t40, user, valid>) -> ptr<t40, user, unknown>

challenges.title: Ternary GCD
challenges.description: Implement the Euclidean GCD algorithm using TCMP for remainder checks. Balanced ternary representation is highly efficient because remainder calculations can be negative without affecting loop termination.
challenges.signature: fn ternary_gcd(a: t40, b: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Ternary Integer Logarithm
challenges.description: Compute the floor of log₃(n) for n > 0. Implement a while loop driven by a T1 condition and terminate it using TCMP-based comparisons.

challenges.title: Base-27 Formatter
challenges.description: Format a t40 value as its base-27 representation with a 0z prefix. Requires extracting digits of base-27 (using base-3 groupings of 3 trits) and outputting characters.
challenges.signature: fn format_base27(n: t40, out_str: borrow_mut<ptr<t40, user, valid>>) -> t40

challenges.title: Fixed-Point Multiply
challenges.description: Multiply two Q13.13 ternary fixed-point values (13 integer trits, 13 fractional trits packed in a t40 word). Handles sign propagation, wide multiplication, and shifting.
challenges.signature: fn q_multiply(a: t40, b: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Multi-Precision Add
challenges.description: Add two big integers represented as arrays of t40 limbs, propagating carries sequentially. This serves as a building block for multi-precision cryptographic math.
challenges.signature: fn bigint_add(a: borrow<[t40]>, b: borrow<[t40]>, out: borrow_mut<[t40]>) -> t40

challenges.title: TLDR/TSTR Spinlock
challenges.description: Implement lock() and unlock() using TLDR/TSTR atomic primitives. Lock state uses T1 values (neg = locked, pos = free). Avoid busy-spinning without a FENCE instruction.
challenges.signature: fn spin_lock(lock_ptr: ptr<t1, shared, valid>) -> t40

challenges.title: Three-Phase Barrier
challenges.description: Synchronize N concurrent threads using atomic decrement (via TLDR/TSTR). Threads pass through approach, wait, and release phases, which map directly onto the three ternary state values.
challenges.signature: fn barrier_wait(counter: ptr<t40, shared, valid>, num_threads: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Epoch-Based Reclamation
challenges.description: Safely reclaim concurrent memory without garbage collection. Threads publish their epoch status in a shared<t40, ACQ_REL> slot. Reclaim buffers only after all threads have moved past the epoch.
challenges.signature: fn try_reclaim(epochs: borrow<[t40]>, reclaim_epoch: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Three-Way Radix Sort
challenges.description: Implement a most-significant-digit (MSD) radix sort that partitions elements by trits. Enables branchless, in-place sorting at the digit level into neg, zero, and pos buckets.
challenges.signature: fn radix_sort(arr: borrow_mut<[t40]>, digit_index: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Ternary Huffman Coding
challenges.description: Build an optimal prefix tree with up to 3 children per node. Satisfies the ternary tree leaf property ((n-1) mod 2 = 0), padding with dummy leaf nodes when required.

challenges.title: TST Delete
challenges.description: Delete a key from a Ternary Search Tree without corrupting prefix matches. Requires recursive safety checks and updating pointer states during node teardown.
challenges.signature: fn tst_delete(root: ptr<t40, user, unknown>, key: borrow<ptr<t40, user, valid>>) -> ptr<t40, user, unknown>

challenges.title: Ternary Skip List
challenges.description: Implement a skip list where each node has a random height. Use TCMP on a random t40 word to determine the level selection probabilistically, achieving O(log₃ n) lookup.
challenges.signature: fn skip_list_search(head: ptr<t40, user, valid>, target: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Interval Tree Query
challenges.description: Store intervals [lo, hi] and query for overlaps. Augment a BST with a max-endpoint field, driving search routing via three-way TCMP comparisons.
challenges.signature: fn interval_search(root: ptr<t40, user, unknown>, q_lo: t40, q_hi: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Constant-Time Select
challenges.description: Return a if condition is pos, b if neg, or c if zero, executing in constant time with no branches. Uses the TSEL hardware instruction directly.
challenges.signature: fn ct_select(cond: t1, a: t40, b: t40, c: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Hensel Lifting Step
challenges.description: Given N and x₀ such that N * x₀ ≡ 1 (mod 3), perform one Newton-Raphson step to double the correct digits. Serves as the core loop of Montgomery reduction parameter setup.
challenges.signature: fn hensel_step(n: t40, x0: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Ternary Feistel Round
challenges.description: Perform one Feistel cipher round. Split a t40 word into two t20 halves, evaluate the round function on one half, and add it mod 3 (tritwise XOR) to the other, then swap halves.
challenges.signature: fn feistel_round(word: t40, key: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Branch-Free Clamp
challenges.description: Clamp a value x to the interval [lo, hi] without using conditional jump instructions (BRN, BRZ, BRP). Optimize cycle count by exploiting TCMP and TSEL.
challenges.signature: fn clamp_branchfree(x: t40, lo: t40, hi: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Sub-Word Pack / Unpack
challenges.description: Pack three t9 values into a single t40 word and extract them. The reference solution uses 8 instructions; find an optimized formulation using 4.
challenges.signature: fn pack_unpack(a: t40, b: t40, c: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Register Pressure Reduction
challenges.description: Rewrite a complex calculation containing multiple intermediate results to reduce register pressure. Fit the logic within 24 registers with zero stack spills.
challenges.signature: fn optimize_registers(a: t40, b: t40, c: t40, d: t40) -> t40

challenges.title: Strength Reduction
challenges.description: Replace multiplication operations with equivalent combinations of shifts and additions. E.g., multiply by 9 using base-3 shift operations to speed up execution.

challenges.title: Peephole Optimization
challenges.description: Analyze a provided assembly sequence and eliminate redundancies such as consecutive identical loads/stores, identity math, or dead branch conditions.

challenges.title: Generic Dot Product
challenges.description: Write a generic dot product function over arrays of width W. Must lower to hardware VMAC instructions when instantiated at T1, or standard multiply-accumulate otherwise.
challenges.signature: fn dot<W: TritWidth>(a: borrow<[T<W>]>, b: borrow<[T<W>]>) -> t40

challenges.title: Width-Parametric Clamp
challenges.description: Create a generic clamp function for elements of width W. Constrain parameters lo and hi to be the exact same width as the input value x.
challenges.signature: fn clamp<W: TritWidth>(x: T<W>, lo: T<W>, hi: T<W>) -> T<W>

challenges.title: Polymorphic Vec Map
challenges.description: Map a function f over an array of elements of width W. Note that TCL 1.0 does not support closures; f must be passed as a named function reference.
challenges.signature: fn vec_map<W: TritWidth>(v: borrow<[T<W>]>, f: fn(T<W>) -> T<W>, out: borrow_mut<[T<W>]>)

challenges.title: Trinfuck Interpreter
challenges.description: Implement an interpreter for Trinfuck (balanced ternary Brainfuck) in TCL 1.0. Program execution details: tape cells span [-9841, +9841], instruction '+' increments, '-' decrements, and ternary branch operators are '[', '{', '}'.

challenges.title: Trinfuck to TASM Compiler
challenges.description: Write a TCL program that compiles Trinfuck code to TASM assembly instructions in memory. Map operations to 1-4 assembly instructions, translating branches to BRZ/BRN/BRP.

challenges.title: Recursive Fibonacci
challenges.description:
Compute the Nth Fibonacci number recursively.

Fibonacci sequence:
- `F(0) = 0`
- `F(1) = 1`
- `F(2) = 1`
- `F(3) = 2`
- `F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2)`

### Constraints
- `0 <= N <= 15`
- Implement it **recursively** to verify proper register spill and call stack mechanics in the VM!

challenges.title: Word-Parallel Tritwise Cost
challenges.description: Apply a tritwise operation to a packed word and preserve the representation-dependent cost contract. The correctness result must match the scalar reference while the published limit records the word-parallel budget.

challenges.title: Ternary Vector Dot Product
challenges.description: Compute a three-lane dot product with balanced ternary values. The fixture keeps the lane order explicit so scalar and vector implementations share one deterministic correctness contract.
